title: Our Story
content_html:
ILANEL Design Studio is a product design company formed in 2010, composing light art and design in Melbourne, australia.

Along with a network of local artisans and fabricators, the ILANEL team is a remarkable blend of creativity, expertise, and passion for exceptional design. With diverse backgrounds and a shared love for craftsmanship, our team members bring a wealth of experience to the table. From skilled artisans to innovative designers, we collaborate seamlessly, embracing each other's strengths to deliver stunning and unique lighting solutions. All products are made-to-order based on the atelier's collection or custom-designed. 

ILANEL's work is internationally recognised for its innovation, merging artisanal craftsmanship with cutting-edge technology to produce pieces that are both timeless and forward-thinking. Whether designing for residential, commercial, or public spaces, Ilan consistently challenges conventional boundaries to create lighting that is not only functional but also an artistic centrepiece.

A nod to nature respects place as an environment, while the application of science reflects our potential as human beings. These motivations meet an intersection of industrial design. The atelier's work takes you into an experiential realm whilst remaining accessible and functional. This medley of experience, observation and sensory function forms a unique take on what would otherwise be a decorative piece.

A conscious adaptation to design affords each luminaire a low impact environmental journey. By using considered materials and processes, ILANEL is in touch with the path of every object from concept to the end of its life cycle.

With over 15 years of local production and international reach, ILANEL continues to meet the demands of modern times with pieces that are efficient and functional while garnering an effect of contemplation.

In 2010, Ilan established ILANEL Design Studio, positioning it as a leader in bespoke lighting design and production.

ABOUT ILAN

Ilan El is the founder and visionary behind ILANEL P/L, a Melbourne-based atelier celebrated for its bespoke luminaires and large-scale light-based installations. Ilan's creative journey began with training and practicing as an architect, where he developed a strong foundation in design and spatial concepts. In 2005, he joined the Master of Design program at RMIT University, where he deepened his understanding of lighting design principles, the physics of light, and its psychological and emotional impact on people.

This transformative experience sparked Ilan's passion for crafting immersive and experiential lighting. Fascinated by the interplay of light, colour, and perception, Ilan explored how light could create emotional resonance and enhance human connections. His designs often incorporate interactive, playful, and automated elements, showcasing light's transformative power to inspire joy and foster a sense of connectivity.

In 2010, Ilan established ILANEL P/L, a practice dedicated to the creation of custom lighting pieces and large-scale installations. His work is characterised by its innovative approach to the visible spectrum, exploring how light interacts with form, movement, and reflection. From glowing sculptural objects to captivating installations, Ilan's creations often transform spaces into dynamic environments that encourage engagement and introspection.

Ilan’s work, highlight his ability to seamlessly blend art, design, and technology. His work has been featured in prestigious events such as the 2020 NGV Triennial, cementing his reputation as a leader in contemporary luminaire design. Through his practice, Ilan continues to redefine the role of light in design, offering experiences that are as functional as they are poetic.

title: FAQ
content_html:
How do I get pricing?

We appreciate your interest in our work and would be happy to provide you with a quote for your specific project or lighting solution you are seeking.

WHY DO YOU NOT PUBLISH PRICES ON YOUR WEBSITE?

We do not publish prices on our website because each order is unique, and the price is affected by various factors, including size, custom options, lengths and finishes.

ARE ILANEL LIGHTS SUITABLE FOR USE OUTSIDE OF AUSTRALIA?

Yes, we have shipped worldwide since we started back in 2010.

All ILANEL lights can be supplied with any overseas components such as lampholders, plugs and drivers to suit any electrical system requirements.

We are always happy to assist with any suggestions/recommendations however, it is best practice to consult your favourite local licensed electrician or certified installer for clarification and confirmation of your requirements.

Do you supply to trade?

Trade prices are available to the construction, architecture and design industries.

To join our Trade Program, head to: ilanel.com/trade

WHERE ARE YOU LOCATED?

We are located in the heart of St Kilda, in inner Melbourne, Victoria.

Our studio is open by appointment Monday to Friday, 9am - 6pm.

Contact us via 03 9534 1164 or info@ilanel.com to arrange your visit.

DO YOU DO CUSTOM & COMMISSION WORK?

Yes, we love collaborating, making the impossible possible and designing our way out of a challenge.

If you have something custom in mind or a bespoke variation to one of our existing pieces, don't hesitate to get in touch. We would love to hear from you!

Explore a small sample of some of our custom and bespoke commission projects on our website at ilanel.com/commission

WHERE ARE YOUR PRODUCTS MADE?

All of our products are designed and made in Melbourne, Australia. Whilst our studio, showroom and workshop are in St Kilda, our team involves a network of highly skilled artisans and fabricators located all across Melbourne.

Some are sole proprietors, others are family-run, often multi-generational. They are all highly skilled craftspeople, repositories of knowledge, problem solvers and one-of-a-kind artisans who are always up for the challenge.

WHAT ARE YOUR LEAD TIMES?

Once an order is received, expected lead times are 4-12 weeks for products from our collection.

Longer lead times apply to modified, custom, and commissioned projects. We always do our very best to supply orders within an agreeable timeframe.

If you have a limited lead time requirement, please contact us prior to submitting your order to discuss as we will always try to accommodate a specific need and where we cannot, you will get an honest response.

WHAT ARE YOUR PAYMENT METHODS?

We accept payment by bank transfer, debit or credit card.

WHERE AND HOW DO YOU SHIP?

We ship all over Australia and worldwide, where permitted.

For International destinations, each work is air-freighted with DHL Express. Any International duties, taxes or VAT are billed by customs to the consignee upon delivery.

WILL MY SHIPMENT BE INSURED?

Yes, ALL shipments domestic or international are fully insured door to door.

DO YOU CARRY OUT THE INSTALLATION?

All our pieces are shipped with a detailed step-by-step Installation Manual.

Each piece is designed to be installed by a licensed electrician or certified installer.

Hardware to operate fixtures (such as switches or dimmers) are the responsibility of your local licensed electrician or licensed installer.

For any additional information regarding installation, email us at info@ilanel.com as we are here to help.

ARE YOUR LIGHTS COMPATIBLE WITH DIMMER SWITCHES?

All our lighting pieces are dimmable, providing you use a compatible dimmer switch. Please consult your favourite local licensed electrician or certified installer for further advice.

Of our pieces requiring an LED globe, it is our standard policy not to ship with globes due to the many varied brands, variations, styles, increase to shipping insurance charges and client preferences.

Our table lamps, which have an inline switch cannot be dimmed.

DO YOUR LIGHTS COME WITH GLOBES, CANOPIES AND FLEX (CORD)?

Globes

All ILANEL lighting is low wattage LED and can be dimmed providing you are using a compatible dimmer switch. Of our pieces where an LED globe is required, it is our standard policy NOT to ship with globes due to the many varied brands, styles, increase to shipping insurance charges, client preferences and for International orders, variations in power requirements. The recommended globe for all our products are included in the Specification Sheet on our website. or is specified

We are always happy to assist with any suggestions/recommendations of where to source your preferred globes.

Flex (cord)

We carry a range of flex colours in stock and can source to meet any special requirements. Drop length required will always be confirmed at the time when your order is placed.

ILANEL carries a range of flex colours in stock and can source to meet any special requirements. Drop length will always be confirmed at the time when your order is placed.

Canopies (Ceiling Plates)

We carry a small amount of canopies or ceiling plates in stock of our most popular items which enables us to ship promptly. As our pieces are creator made we can meet any special requirements you may have from size, shape, colours and finishes you may specify for your canopy (ceiling plate).

CAN ILANEL LIGHTS BE RELOCATED?

Yes, clients often contact us seeking advice on the best way to ensure that their much loved ILANEL lights are wrapped up and shipped as carefully as their prized art when they move premises, we are always happy to assist with technical, shipping advice or replacement parts if needed to ensure your piece/s continue providing their sensory joyfulness.

WHAT IS YOUR RETURNS POLICY?

We want you to be 100% satisfied with your product. If there are any issues as a result of shipping or defects contact us directly as we will rectify or replace if required straight away.

However, if you have simply changed your mind, because all of our pieces are unique and made to order we are unable to provide a refund for your order.

WARRANTY

All ILANEL lighting products are covered by a 2 year commercial or 3 year residential warranty from date of shipping, (not installation) against any defective or faulty work. For more detailed information or to download the product warranty visit the warranty page on our website. View Warranty

SUSTAINABILITY

Sustainability and recycling have been at the core of our practices and have naturally evolved with us in time. We are continuously looking at the mechanics of our designs to ensure they can be un-manufactured for recycling or repurposing as easily as they are manufactured.

We use certified timber, avoid welding and toxic glues in favour of mechanical fixing, our paints are water-based or low VOC (volatile organic compounds) and the anodising process, which produces a liquid waste, is safely disposed of. In addition to thoughtful materials, we create our installations in parts for the best overall finish and peace of mind warranty. Our products are intentionally foolproof from delivery to installation allowing for protection in transport, effortlessness in setting up and long term use.

We re-purpose all inbound cardboard and packaging material wherever possible whilst never compromising the way our products are packaged to ensure they arrive in perfect condition at their destination.

CARE & MAINTENANCE

Our top four suggestions to ensure the maximum longevity of your ILANEL lighting pieces.

Regular cleaning of your pieces ensures they look and perform the best at all times;

Never use abrasive cloths or abrasive detergents/solvents;

Considering the location of your products is important to keep them always looking their best;

Natural elements including direct exposure to sunlight, fluctuating temperatures, moisture and humidity can all affect the longevity of your products.

Fabric Shades

- Remove dust regularly (every few weeks) with an electrostatic duster or dry, soft cloth.

- Spot clean with damp cloth in lukewarm water and mild/diluted detergent only, never use abrasive cloths or abrasive detergents/solvents.

- Whilst our fabrics are treated with an SPF protector be careful to avoid direct sunlight where possible.

Timber

- Remove dust regularly (every few weeks) with a dry, soft cloth or an electrostatic duster.

- Spot clean with a damp cloth using lukewarm water, never use abrasive cloths or abrasive detergents/solvents.

- Minimise where possible direct sunlight, contact with moisture and fluctuating temperatures.

- Whilst our stains include an SPF protector, be careful to avoid direct sunlight where possible.

Glass

- Remove dust regularly (every few weeks) with a dry, soft cloth or an electrostatic duster.

- Remove any marks with a soft cloth dampened using lukewarm water, diluted with a mild glass cleaner, isopropyl or diluted methylated spirit.

METALS

Brass

- Polishing our brass products coated with a clear enamel to preserve the polished finish is not required.

- Our ‘living’ metal brass products will age gracefully and do not require polishing.

- Wipe dust off regularly with a dry soft cloth or an electrostatic duster every few weeks.

- Spot clean with damp cloth in lukewarm water only, never use abrasive cloths or abrasive detergents/solvents.

Powder Coated Metals

- Remove dust regularly (every few weeks) with a dry, soft cloth or an electrostatic duster.

- Spot clean with damp cloth in lukewarm water only, never use abrasive cloths or abrasive detergents/solvents.

- Take care at all times when handling to avoid scratching or chipping of the protective powder coat finish.

Linished Aluminium

- Remove dust regularly (every few weeks) with a dry, soft cloth or an electrostatic duster.

- Spot clean with damp cloth in lukewarm water only, never use abrasive cloths or abrasive detergents/solvents.

title: Privacy Policy
content_html:
Privacy policy

We regard customer privacy as an important and vital part of our relationship with our customers. The following privacy policy applies to all users of the domain www.ilanel.com and conforms to internet privacy standards. If you have questions or concerns regarding this statement, please contact info@ilanel.com

Collection of information

In order to use the www.ilanel.com website, we may require information from you in order to provide the best service possible. All correspondence may also be collected and stored, particularly in regard to sales, support and accounts, including email addresses and login details. Any information collected by ilanel is collected via correspondence from you or your company. This may be via the telephone, email, mail, fax or directly through our website.

Use of collection information

Any details collected from our customers are required in order to provide you with our products and/or services, and a high level of customer service. Correspondence is recorded in order to provide service references, and to assist in our staff development.

Access to collected information

If your personally identifiable information changes, or if you no longer desire our service, you may correct, update, delete or deactivate it by emailing us at info@ilanel.com

Communications

ILANEL Design Studio uses personally identifiable information for essential communications, such as emails, accounts information, and critical service details. We may also use this information for other purposes, including some promotional emails. If at any time a customer wishes not to receive such correspondence, they can request to be removed from our mailing list by emailing us at info@ilanel.com

Third parties

ILANEL Design Studio may at its discretion use other third parties to provide essential services on our site or for our business processes. We may share your details as necessary for the third party to provide that service. These third parties are prohibited from using your personally identifiable information for any other purpose. ILANEL Design Studio does not share any information with third parties for any unknown or unrelated uses

Legal

ILANEL Design Studio reserves the right to disclose your personally identifiable information as required by law and when we believe that disclosure is necessary to protect our rights and/or comply with a judicial proceeding, court order, or legal process served on our website.

Changes to privacy policy

If we decide to change our privacy policy, we will post those changes to this privacy statement, the homepage, and other places we deem appropriate so that you are aware of what information we collect, how we use it, and under what circumstances, if any, we disclose it. We reserve the right to modify this privacy statement at any time, so please review it frequently. If we make material changes to this policy, we will notify you here, by email, or by means of a notice on our homepage.
